excerpts.author: jessepollak
excerpts.content:
given it looks like we're convering to the queueless withdrawals approach (https://hackmd.io/@benjaminion/SkCPPHZHs), is that what we should point our nose towards in terms of rebasing on top of capella for devnet-3?

cc <@363800010518822915> <@898563924440543283>

excerpts.author: terencechain
excerpts.content: Correct. The withdrawal pr in the consensus spec should be merged in the next 2 days so we can rebase on top of that 🙂

excerpts.author: __flcl
excerpts.content: EL should have Shanghai too, right?

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content: <@561275259454619659> prysm develop already contains all the Capella structures, we need to change some names, but that should be fine for your testing I suppose, you can just mock all validators to have 31ETH and not be exited

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content: Or simply not use any Capella code

excerpts.author: terencechain
excerpts.content: TLDR: prysm can support 4844 on top of capella or not-capella. It should be simple to support one of two. We should finalize the devnet3 scope 🔜

excerpts.author: jessepollak
excerpts.content:
<@159152274659082240> would you mind updating your Capella rebase spec change (https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3052) to mirror the latest structures from the consensus call?

Once we have that, we can lock that in as included in devnet3 scope. once that's confirmed, i believe we will have a fully finalized spec, which we can review and confirm at the implementers call on Tuesday.

https://notes.ethereum.org/@timbeiko/4844-devnet-3
